text:
maria gomez: Hey team — quick sync. Snowflake wants to run a small field trial of the Vector Connector with 10 customers next month. Can we confirm readiness and what we need for a marketplace listing?

jake li: +1. Do we have a supported config for Snowflake + FAISS/PGVector flows?

anita shah: We have a beta connector that writes embeddings to Snowflake VARBINARY and also supports external functions for retrieval. Need to validate with their security team.

chris ng: For Databricks flow it's slightly different — we rely on Delta + vector UDFs. We'll need a small adapter so our SDK picks the right retrieval path.

maria gomez: Action items: security signoff, marketplace package, demo notebook, joint customer comms. Can each owner confirm ETA?

jake li: I can take marketplace package + demo notebook. ETA EOD next Tue. Demo will include a minimal notebook + streaming example.

anita shah: I'll own security signoff with Snowflake — submitting our architecture diagram and threat model tomorrow. Ping me if you need anything specific.

chris ng: I'll do the Databricks adapter PR. Estimate 5 working days. Will add tests against small vector DB (pgvector) and our quantized model locally.

maria gomez: Partner ask also includes a co-branded announcement and a checkbox for "supported on marketplace" — can partnerships prepare boilerplate?

partner-bot: :information_source: New checklist created: `sf-vector-field-trial-1771` (assigned to maria, jake, anita)

anita shah: Heads up — Snowflake legal asked for data residency notes. We should document that embeddings persisted in customer accounts are retained per their retention settings and that we don't cache PII.

jake li: Good call. In demo notebook I'll add a short section: "Data controls & retention" and a snippet showing how to set retention policy.

chris ng: For the Databricks + Delta pipeline, performance numbers vary by shard size. I'll include perf matrix (latency @ 64/128 dims, throughput on r5 vs g5).

maria gomez: Can someone draft the marketplace listing copy? Need 150–200 chars for the marketplace tile + a longer description. I can start a draft but want product review.

jake li: I'll draft the tile and send to product for edits. Also need the icon and screenshots — design already has a connector icon in /assets/connectors.

anita shah: Security will require an architecture diagram + minimal dataflow. Chris can you export the Databricks flow?

chris ng: Yep, will export Visio and PNG by tomorrow.

maria gomez: Timeline check: we want trial start in 3 weeks. That gives us 2 weeks to finish materials and 1 week for partner signoff. Is that realistic?

jake li: Tight but doable if we prioritize marketplace + demo. Dev work can ship as beta.

anita shah: Snowflake security calendar has a 5 business day review slot next Wed — so we need docs in by Mon COB.

maria gomez: Ok. Final ask: collect a single ZIP with docs, notebook, listing copy, assets, and test results. Drop into the shared Drive under Partnerships/SF-vector-trial by Friday midday.

partner-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder set: upload deadline Friday 12:00 UTC (channel: partnerships)

chris ng: I'll upload perf logs and adapter PR link once CI passes.

jake li: I'll push the demo notebook and listing draft to the Drive today.

anita shah: Security docs ready draft by Mon morning.

maria gomez: Perfect. If anything blocks, @maria gomez here. Thanks team :rocket:
